analysis_repair: Original workflow stopped at first analysis because perf omits IbsOpRip when RipInvalid is set. New decoder allows an omitted RIP only with that flag and joins actual perf IP. Original helpers/pins/failure retained; new offline-only plan continues remaining decode; no capture or Gnark repeated.
